SELECT IFNULL(SUM(base_salary), 0) AS salary, IFNULL(SUM(bonus), 0) AS bonus, IFNULL(SUM(deduction), 0) AS deduction FROM salary WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') FROM salary ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(base_salary), 0) FROM salary GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(bonus), 0) FROM salary GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(deduction), 0) FROM salary GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')

SELECT d.department_name AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS people, SUM(s.base_salary) AS salary, SUM(s.bonus) AS bonus, SUM(s.deduction) AS deduction, SUM(s.real_salary) AS `real` FROM department d LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN salary s ON s.employee_id = e.id GROUP BY d.id, d.department_name
SELECT * FROM salary WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT( CASE WHEN salary_status = '待发放' THEN 1 END ) AS pendingCount,
IFNULL( SUM( CASE WHEN salary_status = '已发放' THEN real_salary END ), 0 ) AS paidSalary,
IFNULL( SUM( CASE WHEN salary_status = '待发放' THEN real_salary END ), 0 ) AS pendingAmount
FROM salary
WHERE salary_month = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')

SELECT s.id, s.employee_id AS employeeId, e.name AS name, s.salary_month AS salaryMonth, s.attendance_days AS attendanceDays, s.base_salary AS baseSalary, s.bonus, s.deduction, s.tax, s.real_salary AS realSalary, s.salary_status AS salaryStatus, s.create_time AS createTime
FROM salary s
LEFT JOIN employee e ON s.employee_id = e.id
